glosses: To place within a fluid (generally a liquid, but also a gas).

examples.text: Archimedes determined the volume of objects by immersing them in water.

examples.text: The sculptor immersed himself in anatomic studies.

glosses: To map into an immersion.

examples.text: Thus, in mathematical terms a Klein bottle cannot be "embedded" but only "immersed" in three dimensions as an embedding has no self-intersections but an immersion may have them.
